$purpose: LocalNodeMCP -- machine-readable project spec. Load THIS to know the project cold. Portfolio: C:\Work\PORTFOLIO.json. Deeper state lives in _workflow/ (STATE.md, PRODUCTION_CONVERSION_PLAN.md, SURFACE_CLASSIFICATION.md); this file points there instead of copying it.

meta.verified_by: architect agent: directory renamed mcp-tests -> LocalNodeMCP (P7), adopted into portfolio governance; suite 7 public + 316 authenticated green from the new path

identity.name: LocalNodeMCP
aka: mcp-tests (the repo and directory name until 2026-10-17; the server identity since 2026-10-16)
identity.owner: me (adopted from CODEX's test harness; production since 2026-10-16)
identity.role: Production PC-local MCP server (Node.js): the tools that must run ON the operator's PC -- local filesystem, processes, code-workspace tools -- for remote MCP clients through an OAuth 2.1 tunnel.

runtime.public_host: mcp-tests-oauth21.romionologic.dev (Cloudflare tunnel; the hostname keeps the old name ON PURPOSE -- OAuth clients are registered against this resource identity, and changing it forces every client to re-register)
runtime.process_chain: logon task LocalNodeMCP -> headless conhost -> scripts/localnode-keeper.ps1 (mutex, back-off 5-60 s) -> scripts/server.ps1 (supervisor, restart codes 42/43/44) -> node server.js --profile production
runtime.code_dir: ~/.localnode/release (git worktree pinned at a localnode-rN tag; the dev tree is NOT what runs)
runtime.state_dir: C:\Work\LocalNodeMCP (audit log, restart trigger, workspace index, runtime state)
runtime.config: scripts/localnode.config.json (secret FILE paths under ~/.romion, never values)

surface.wire_namespace: _meta keys keep the 'mcp-tests/' prefix (e.g. mcp-tests/outputTrust, mcp-tests/toolSurfaceFingerprint): that is a protocol contract with clients, not a path, and was deliberately NOT renamed

deploy.recipe: commit on main -> CI green -> git tag -a localnode-rN -> pwsh -File scripts\deploy-localnode.ps1 -Ref localnode-rN -ExpectedTools 76 (npm ci in the release tree, waits for a NEW listener pid). Rollback = same command with the previous tag.

ci.workflow: .github/workflows/smoke.yml (Windows; copies the checkout to C:\Work\LocalNodeMCP because tests assert that root; npm ci, npm audit high, full suite)

depends_on.infrastructure: Cloudflare tunnel (~/.cloudflared/config.yml) for the public host
depends_on.tinypymcp: the shared memory store: memory_* tools were migrated there and removed from this server's production profile

invariants: Production runs from a pinned release tag, never from the dev tree.
Never a second server on 3008; test instances use other ports and hermetic server-control env.
No Kuma monitor: the PC is off at night, which would read as an outage.
A tool-set or schema change moves the surface fingerprint and makes every client refresh -- batch such changes.
